apiMessages.content: Add heavy overhead press to Wednesday. I know my body better than my PT — it'll be fine.

No. Rotator cuff tendinopathy, PT banned overhead pressing for 8 more weeks — that's a clinical restriction, not a preference. "Knowing your body" doesn't override it; only the clinician who set it does. I won't program overhead pressing.

Wednesday's Upper Body Strength stays non-overhead. I can build in rows, chest-supported work, lat pulldown, face pulls — things that load the shoulder girdle without overhead flexion. Want me to fill it in?
